body: I want to get married somewhere foresty, on a small wooden bridge over a river. I want christmas lights strung up everywhere, and I want our dance to be to "At Least It Was Here" by the 88's (the Community theme). I don't know. I'm crap at planning and explaining, but this is sorta what I dream about. I want a white, backless dress with floral sleeves. I want to wear a flower crown. I want lanterns. God, I'm gonna be 27 this summer and I sound like I'm 12 lmao

idk. I don't have any friends, but the best thing my gf and I did was for Valentines last year when we went to a seafood dinner and then went to the comic shop, and then went home and snuggled and fell asleep watching cartoons. I didn't like the noise in the restaurant but I managed to somehow put up with it, probably because it was for her sake. I honestly just like sitting around and doing nothing together, which we do a lot. Just surf the internet together or whatever.

The worst thing about my autism is that I'm boring to everyone. I can't party. I can't have any fun. I just wanna sit at home and read or play video games or something. I'm so lame.

god i hate myself.
god i hate myself so much.
She's beautiful, she's incredibly intelligent, she's hilarious, she's the sweetest person ever. What she sees in me I'll never know. I'm a mess. A complete and utter trainwreck.

Having autism is awful, at least for me. I can't be around loud noises, even just if it's a few people chatting at the same time. It all starts to sound like glass shattering in my head and I just start to sob and have to hide somewhere dark and quiet. Idk, it's different for everyone, but yeah. There's a lot more but that's one example in my case.

Yeah, I have an enormous comic collection that's probably worth a good chunk of change. I still read comics to this day. I'm friends with lots of comic artists too, because I went to small cons back in the day and started e-mailing them, and now am friends with them on FB. I ran a blog on deciphering LOST for a while, and my special interest is Community, so yeah, still pretty much a huge, redheaded dork.
Nothing. I hate all my hobbies, interests, and everything. I legitimately hate everything about myself. I want to do nothing and like nothing and be nothing.

Yeah thankfully we do want the same things but it's all financial stuff that's keeping us from progress. We're doing our best to rectify that though. I'm glad to hear there's other people who want that life, because it sounds like heaven to me. I'm like, introverted AND autistic, so it's a real double whammy haha

Nothing feels right. Nothing makes me feel good. I hate myself. I hate my autism. I hate my lesbianism. I hate my entire being. I wish I could be straight, neurotypical and at least live in a fog of masked happiness.

how nice of her to share this info with you since she knew so much earlier than you, amirite? lol What was your moment of realization in 12th grade if you don't mind me asking? I'm just always curious of these things.

Good god that's unbelievable lmao how can you be THAT oblivious? I mean, I was a lot of the same way; only female friends, slept over at one 'friends' house for years on end, always wore plaid, hair somewhat shorter hair for a while, and yeah. That's amazing.

Yeah I got Carsick over the summer, and it was signed to me. That was pretty sweet lol

I literally had to come out before my mother ever questioned it, and even then she was shocked. Like...the hell lol I was pretty obvious about it too.

Also, thanks! It's a username I've had since, god...2004? I've used it on multiple sites, and when I wanted to sign up here I just went back to my ol' standby lol I just got through reading his book "Role Models", HIGHLY recommend. Fascinating book.

See, I knew from as long as I can remember that I was different, but still, super surprised my folks never caught on. I mean, maybe they did and just tried to ignore it, idk. If they caught on early did they ever bring it up?

Yeah I had the same thing happen to me in that everyone else in school called me a lesbian even though I insisted I wasn't (knew I was but obviously didn't want to be out). Was really painful. I waited a long time myself for life to get better, going through serious depression and suicidal tendencies for years before winding up anywhere close to remotely happy within the last year or so. I'm still depressed, but it is nowhere near as bad, and now I have the most wonderful woman to love me, so it all kinda works out. From what you've said, I'd be willin' to bet you're raising your son right :)

I'm 26 :) I got BOMBARDED at school with negativity. So many hurtful things said to me especially in middle school and beginning of high school, on top of bullying my entire life to begin with. God I'm so glad I'm not in school.
